figurative_meaning_en: the play of life; the game of the world
example_sentences_in_bangla: জীবনটা একটা বাজি, কখন কী ঘটবে কে জানে।
এই ভবের খেলায় সবাই বাজি খেলছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Life is a bet; who knows what will happen next.
In this game of the world, everyone is playing their wager.
history: Derived from the devotional song by 18th-century Bengali poet Ramprasad Sen: 'এবার বাজি ভোর হল, ও মন কী খেলা বল', reflecting themes of life's transience in Kali worship.
note: Primarily used in literary and philosophical contexts to denote life's unpredictability.
